newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss April inflation steady at 0.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss April inflation steady at 0.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Swiss consumer prices rose 0.1 percent in April from the previous month for an unchanged year-on-year inflation rate of 0.5 percent, the Federal Statistics Office said.
Monthly CPI index change +0.1 pct -0.1 pct +0.1 pct Yr/yr inflation +0.5 pct +0.5 pct +0.9 pct

The office said in a statement the slight rise in April prices was due to a 0.4 percent rise in health costs, mainly from higher hospital fees, and 0.2 percent rise in the cost of food, drinks and tobacco and a 0.2 percent rise in the cost of transport and communication.
The sub-index for rents and energy was practically stable.
Prices of both domestic goods and imported goods rose 0.1 percent in April for an average annual price rise on 0.7 percent for domestic goods and 0.1 percent for imported goods.
